LanguageData.CC_Saint_Deed_Rescuer: who died carrying the wounded out of the fight
LanguageData.CC_Saint_Deed_Defender: who held the line to the last
LanguageData.CC_Saint_Deed_Healer: who kept the sick for years
LanguageData.CC_Saint_Deed_Keeper: who kept the faith all their days
LanguageData.CC_Saint_Deed_Vow: who kept a vow to the very end
LanguageData.CC_Saint_Impact_Named: {SAINT}: the grave becomes a place to pray, the day is kept each year by the devoted, and a relic is set aside
LanguageData.CC_Saint_RelicForm_0: a lock of hair bound in knotted cord
LanguageData.CC_Saint_RelicForm_1: a small bone in a carved box
LanguageData.CC_Saint_RelicForm_2: a lock of hair under glass
LanguageData.CC_Saint_RelicForm_3: a recording of their voice sealed in a small case
LanguageData.CC_Saint_RelicSet_Grave: A keepsake of {SAINT}'s was set aside by the grave, to be kept as a relic: {FORM}.
LanguageData.CC_Saint_RelicSet: {PAWN} set a keepsake of {SAINT}'s aside, to be kept as a relic: {FORM}.
LanguageData.CC_Saint_Why_Damned: Their faith, {FAITH}, speaks of {SAINT} only with fear.
LanguageData.CC_Saint_Book_Day_Male: His day is kept each year on the day he died.
LanguageData.CC_Saint_Book_Day_Female: Her day is kept each year on the day she died.
LanguageData.CC_Saint_Book_Day_None: Their day is kept each year on the day they died.
LanguageData.CC_Saint_Book_Faith: The faith of {FAITH} holds {SAINT} among its {WORD}.
LanguageData.CC_Saint_Book_Damned: The faith of {FAITH} fears {SAINT}, and never prays to them.
LanguageData.CC_Saint_Book_Gone: {SAINT}, kept no more by the faith of {FAITH}.
LanguageData.CC_Saint_FeastQuiet: {SAINT}'s day: {WHO} kept it quietly, each where they were.
LanguageData.CC_Saint_Gizmo_Desc: Raise this statue to one of the saints: the colony's own, or one of its people's faiths'. Someone walks over and says the words, the art takes the saint's name, and from then on the devoted come here now and then to pray to them.
LanguageData.CC_Saint_Gizmo_None: No saints yet: the council has named none of the colony's own, and its people's faiths have none.
LanguageData.CC_Saint_RaiseAsked: Someone will go to the {PLACE} and raise it to {SAINT}.
LanguageData.CC_Saint_RaiseLetGo: Nobody came to say the words at the {PLACE}, so it stays as it was.
LanguageData.CC_Saint_Raised: {PAWN} said the words at the {PLACE}: it stands for {SAINT} now, and anyone may pray there.
LanguageData.CC_Saint_Likeness: The {PLACE} is {SAINT}'s likeness, and people have begun to pray before it.
LanguageData.CC_Saint_Inspect_Pending: Waiting for someone to raise it to {SAINT}.
LanguageData.CC_Saint_Inspect_Statue: Raised to {SAINT} by {PAWN}: a place to pray to them.
LanguageData.CC_Saint_Inspect_Likeness: {SAINT}'s likeness: a place to pray to them.
LanguageData.CC_Saint_Inspect_Grave: The grave of {SAINT}, {DEED}: a place to pray to them.
